sam: quick note — saw reproducible KV-cache misalignment with int8+fused kernels on long-context runs (~40k). generates fine then at ~39,750 tokens we start seeing token duplication and a latency spike.

reno: duplication + latency? paste tiny repro and logs. is this on rescaled RoPE path?

sam: repro below. rescaled RoPE. float32/16 fine. int8 shows dupes and tail-latency ~200ms spikes. toggling kv_stride_align=128 moves the onset.

```
# local repro
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-int8-fused","input":"<40k prompt>"}' > out.json
jq .out[39740:39790] out.json
```

tara: logs?

sam: log excerpt:
```
[2026-06-15T11:42:09Z] INFO dec tok=39748 kv_ptr=39748
[2026-06-15T11:42:10Z] INFO dec tok=39749 kv_ptr=39749
[2026-06-15T11:42:11Z] INFO dec tok=39750 kv_ptr=39749  # duplicate observed
[2026-06-15T11:42:11Z] WARN memcpy_align mismatch: src_offset=63600 dst_offset=63600 align=64
[2026-06-15T11:42:11Z] WARN kv_tile_sync delayed
```

reno: memcpy_align mismatch + delayed tile sync suggests vectorized memcpy path in quant kernel assumes 128-byte lanes but runtime compiled a 64-byte path for int8. could be a cuda kernel launch flag difference or cooperative groups reduction that changed alignment.

tara: also check the half-accumulator used in the attention scorer; we had a recent change to use fp16 accum for speed in int8 path. fp16 accumulation + packed KV layout could increase rounding that manifests only after many tokens.

sam: experiment: switching accumulator to fp32 removes duplication but latency spikes persist. forcing memcpy to fallback scalar path removes both issues. so two orthogonal bugs: alignment assumption in memcpy and fp16 accumulation precision.

ci-bot: build 2026.06.15-quantfuse completed on branch quant/memfix  tests: 230 passed, 4 flaky (longctx).

reno: plan: (1) patch memcpy vector path to check runtime lane width and fallback, (2) add compensated accumulator option guarded by MAX_CTX threshold, (3) add longctx-quant nightly that runs to 50k tokens and checks for kv_ptr monotonicity.

tara: add telemetry metric kv_ptr_delta_non1_total and kv_memalign_mismatch_total. alert if either > 0.5/hour/node.

sam: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/rt-runtime/pull/5019 with memcpy guard, acc guard, repro, and test. perf: memcpy guard negligible, guarded fp32-acc add ~0.8% throughput hit on microbench. will include benchmark.

ops-bot: scheduled staging-run longctx-48h with int8-fuse once CI green.

reno: backport candidate? if customer traces show this, yes. tag SRE & CS on PR.

sam: found one customer log in ticket RD-3589 with similar dupes. will add to PR and request expedited review. thanks all :thumbsup:
